editorial.blurb: Au Chavel is an iconic Chicago burger destination that lives up to the hype with an unforgettable cheeseburger and an unmistakably rambunctious American vibe.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the single burger (actually a double) with a fried egg and thick-cut bacon added—arrive on a Sunday afternoon around 2pm to avoid the 50+ minute waits during peak hours, and sit at the bar if possible.
